record.description: shabby-battens timber indoor door, its existing two jambs and lintel, beside fantasy.wall.g1 with fantasy.wall.g10 above the opening.

identity.validation_level: Measured source floor/contact and image/depth physical mount; not vendor-exact hidden geometry or collision certification.
identity.vendor_unity_compatibility: No generated-door identity or original vendor composition recovered from preserved Unity prefab/scene/meta text.

mounting.registration_space: Measured source floor/contact and physical mount; see physical_mount.
mounting.plane: Use the measured physical_mount source-to-local calibration and floor contact once.

game_profile_authoring.status: render_equivalent_size_estimate_from_measured_source_camera; proposed physical dimensions, not source metric units

continuous_profile_provenance.classification: Actual evaluated source frame extent; lattice conversion remains a size proposal, not a validated mounted collider.
continuous_profile_provenance.policy: Keep the signed lower extent. Source jamb feet penetrate the nominal source floor; do not clamp minZ to0 or silently raise the assembly.

e.meaning: Positive is a visible gap; negative is frame/header overlap. Visible closed-frame alpha only; edge silhouette columns omitted. This measures the preserved 2D montage, not solid wall geometry or a continuous seam.

s.meaning: Positive is a visible gap; negative is frame/header overlap. Visible closed-frame alpha only; edge silhouette columns omitted. This measures the preserved 2D montage, not solid wall geometry or a continuous seam.

w.meaning: Positive is a visible gap; negative is frame/header overlap. Visible closed-frame alpha only; edge silhouette columns omitted. This measures the preserved 2D montage, not solid wall geometry or a continuous seam.

n.meaning: Positive is a visible gap; negative is frame/header overlap. Visible closed-frame alpha only; edge silhouette columns omitted. This measures the preserved 2D montage, not solid wall geometry or a continuous seam.

parts.selection: Recovered preview floor; another existing support is outside this profile.

parts.composition: Use full bank once, or the disjoint frame and leaf components. Never full bank plus its frame again.

parts.evidence: Exact neighboring partitions in the selected recovered example; the same stencil is explicitly proposed for original shabby.
Exact neighboring partitions in the selected recovered example; the same stencil is explicitly proposed for original shabby.

compatible_pieces.compatibility_scope: Specific recovered logical pairing and per-view2D montage; shared physical3D mounting is not validated.

blocking.status: physical authoring description; no new gameplay binding
blocking.mounted_profile_status: Continuous source shapes measured; combined mounting across four camera views is unvalidated.
blocking.closed_leaf: Rigid timber leaf occupies the aperture; preserve existing state-based passage owner.
blocking.fixed_frame: Two narrow jamb solids and upper lintel. The open aperture is not a full-cell solid.
blocking.open_leaf: Retain source leaf geometry and its existing authored swing; do not fill the aperture using the full sprite silhouette.

inward.method: Rigid transformation of measured closed leaf vertices about existing source hinge at only the existing authored pose angles; sampled enclosure, not a new animation or continuous sweep guarantee.

outward.method: Rigid transformation of measured closed leaf vertices about existing source hinge at only the existing authored pose angles; sampled enclosure, not a new animation or continuous sweep guarantee.

do_not_substitute: other thick exterior foundation/frame pieces without their own assembly evidence
constraints.animation_policy: Existing12 inward/outward banks, existing hinge and closing order retained; no timing, hinge, artwork or depth changes.
constraints.space_policy: Keep sampled existing open-leaf enclosure free of neighboring solids on the selected swing side. Sampled enclosure is not a new continuous-collision rule.

source_camera_crosswalk.explicit_door_local_mount: Rotate shared native XY by +90 degrees: cells=(sourceY,sourceX)*k, tangent along nativeY for e wall.

montage_registration_comparison.comparison_assumption: Align nominal source floor origin to a single anchor, using the declared door-local(sourceY,sourceX) axes and native quarter projection. This compares preserved values; it does not author a correction.
montage_registration_comparison.conclusion: S/N montage offsets do not match the measured source geometric quarter mapping under a single shared physical anchor. Per-view visual joins do not validate a coherent3D assembly.
montage_registration_comparison.data_action: Preserve rows and pivots. Flag incompatibility; no row relabel, inferred pose fallback or offset correction.

source_camera_crosswalk.status: Verified geometric crosswalk recorded separately. Existing source labels, selected pivots, bank rows and runtime behavior remain unchanged.

sources.role: Existing pose-specific mounting pivots and scales
Existing actual G10/G1, D5/D8, F5/F8 montage placements

mounting.registration_space: Recovered2D montage registration; independent of the measured source camera/native quarter crosswalk.
mounting.plane: Source leaf lies in Blender X/Z; Blender Y is thickness. Use existing montage mounting pivots exactly once.

e.placement_contact_kind: Recovered per-view2D montage anchor; not a validated shared3D floor contact.

s.placement_contact_kind: Recovered per-view2D montage anchor; not a validated shared3D floor contact.

w.placement_contact_kind: Recovered per-view2D montage anchor; not a validated shared3D floor contact.

n.placement_contact_kind: Recovered per-view2D montage anchor; not a validated shared3D floor contact.

historical_montage_mount.identity_validation_level: Recovered logical placement and independently registered2D montage; not a validated coherent3D wall/frame/leaf assembly.

physical_mount.physical_origin: Actual source floor plane at the centre of the clear opening; source jamb penetration below this plane retained.

adjacent_piece_rebase.rule: For the recovered prefab stencil, subtract the common floor offset from header, support and neighboring partition origins; keep their authored contacts and each own source calibration. Use the measured native crosswalk; the old S/N montage pivot cannot establish a physical mount.
adjacent_piece_rebase.scope: Recovered specific compatible families only. This closes physical image/geometry correspondence; it does not create vendor-exact hidden colliders or new adjacency bindings.

calibration.pixel_coordinates: native128 frame top-left pixel centers (x+0.5,y+0.5), absolute in the native frame; no pivot subtraction
calibration.colour_to_native: sample native pixel index (floor(colour_x/2),floor(colour_y/2)); ray coordinate = that index +0.5
calibration.normalBasis: Existing BA source [BlenderX,-BlenderY,BlenderZ]; actual inverse transpose here, then assembly world orientation exactly once.

mounting.scope: All existing frames and both swing directions; unchanged source hinge and camera.
